links.outcome: Prediction performance against proxy labels, and robustness to variations in risk labeling
links.effect: The interpretable CSO model was outperformed by XGBoost on prediction metrics but was more robust to variations in risk labeling. CSO AUC-ROC was 0.91 vs 0.86 for the current JHFRAT. The abstract gives no XGBoost figures.
links.tradeoff: The interpretable CSO model had lower predictive performance than the black-box XGBoost model.
links.quote: The ablation analyses also suggest that the CSO model, though outperformed in prediction metrics by the benchmark black-box XGBoost model, is more robust than XGBoost to variations in risk labeling.

design_hint: local recalibration of risk score weights
